The main takeaway from our work is that

network change is not a simple process of adding new links or deleting old ones, but a more complex process of adding new ties, dissolving existing ones and changing the nature of existing links (i.e. the nature of relationships between nodes).
the network structure of a field is a dynamic process, not a static one, and that it is possible to observe and understand the processes that drive this evolution.
network dynamics are driven not just by endogenous mechanisms, but also by exogenous shocks.
